common: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production transparent pixel-art monster animation atlas for a Korean fantasy RPG. Request: Masterpiece detailed 32-bit pixel art, SNES era aesthetic, handcrafted pixel clusters, strictly crisp stepped black outlines, limited deliberate palette, high contrast color-graded shadows, small patterned dithering only inside texture surfaces. Every colored edge is visibly square pixel stepped. No 3D, vector shapes, gradients, blurry shading, glow haze, anti-aliasing, painterly texture, noise. Actual transparent alpha background across the entire empty canvas, never gray checkerboards painted in. No labels, text, borders, ground shadows, scenery. Slightly cute chibi proportions, expressive and recognisable, suitable for muted-bright meadow game. Isometric-ish top-down RPG character camera facing screen-right. FULL BODY every pose with feet/claws/wingtips/weapons visible and generous clear gutters; same creature design, scale, baseline and facing repeated in each column. Input image is a species/identity/layout reference only, do not preserve its soft shaded rendering. Redraw all six creatures in actual crisp coarse pixel art. Exact layout 6 equal columns by 4 equal rows, 24 sprites total, wide 1536x1024 canvas. Column species from left to right: (1) bright leaf-green goblin large ears mustard leather vest small wooden club; (2) small orange-brown wild dog cream muzzle pointed ears bushy cream-tip tail; (3) brown bristly boar tusks and bluegray back spikes; (4) stout brown mole cream digging claws steel-blue helmet and round warm headlamp; (5) little cream mushroom spirit red white-spotted cap two green leafarms; (6) pale blue moon wolf white chest cyan crescent forehead fluffy tail. Preserve identity of every column. Row1 idle, Row2 walking with near foreleg advancing, Row3 alternate walking far foreleg advancing, Row4 attack leaning forward (goblin club raised, dog/boar/wolf open mouth lunging, mole swipe, mushroom arms extended). Fit each creature with all its extremities inside its own cell and leave at least 24 transparent pixels around it. Aim for a 48px-tall native sprite scaled with nearest-neighbor 3x inside each cell, distinct 3x3 pixel blocks, do not turn them into smooth illustrations. No title or footnote.
